name: Wall of Ice

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a dome or globe up to 10 feet in radius, or ten connected 10-foot panels

upcast.text: The wall's damage rises by 2d6 and the frigid air's by 1d6 per slot level above 6.

summary: A wall of ice: creatures in its path are pushed aside and make a Dex save, 10d6 Cold, half on a success.
text: Make a dome or globe up to 10 feet in radius, or ten connected 10-foot panels, all 1 foot thick. Each 10-foot section has AC 12 and 30 Hit Points (Vulnerable to Fire); a broken section leaves frigid air that deals 5d6 Cold (Con save for half) to a creature first passing through it on a turn.
